Java Programmer – Spring Boot & Microservices (3–8 Years)

We are looking for Java Programmers with Spring Boot and Microservices experience who are smart, write intelligent code, and can hit the ground running. You will be a part of a dynamic software development team responsible for all aspects of the development cycle, from requirement gathering to design, development, testing, and deployment.




Location: Chennai, Bangalore (or Work from Home, Remotely)
Experience Required: Java Programmers with 3-8 years of experience

Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain RESTful services
Build scalable microservices-based systems
Optimize application performance
Participate in architecture discussions
Requirements
Strong Java (JDK 8+) experience
Spring Boot expertise
Microservices and cloud deployment experience
Experience with relational databases and Git
